name: 种族与各族体系
intro:
西幻种族不按「人妖魔仙」四分，而按欧洲宇宙观的「存在之链」（Great Chain of Being）排列：天界存在 → 妖精与长生种 → 凡人诸族 → 变形者与诅咒者 → 亡灵 → 深渊存在，元素生灵与龙在链外。每个种族有自己的社会等级链（狼群的 Alpha、吸血鬼的长老、妖精宫廷的爵位）；族与族之间没有统一的等级；跨族比较用威胁度（BS00），见 systems.md 的跨体系换算表。

「欧美短剧热度」一栏依据调研：狼人、吸血鬼、妖精、天使/恶魔、人鱼是女性向主力题材，看重清晰的社会等级与命定羁绊；龙、兽人、亡灵多见于男性向。

subgroups.name: 天界存在
subgroups.intro: 存在之链的最上层：天使与天恩之子。

entries.name: 天使
entries.summary: 天界的使者与战士：由纯粹的光与秩序构成，奉命行事，不能违背其被造的职责。堕落者成为最可怕的恶魔。

xianxia.concept: 天兵天将 / 仙官（参照）
xianxia.note: 差异：天使不修炼，品级是被赋予的；它们最大的戏剧性在于「自由意志」——质疑命令即开始堕落。

details.本族等级链: 三阶九级（取自中世纪天使学，本库只借结构）：下阶——使者 Messengers、守护者 Guardians、领域君 Principalities；中阶——权能 Powers、德能 Virtues、主宰 Dominions；上阶——座天使 Thrones、智天使 Cherubim、炽天使 Seraphim
details.核心规则: 不能撒谎、不能违命；在凡世需借凡人之躯或付出代价；坠落即失去光
details.欧美观众热度: 高：堕落天使、天使守护者之恋

entries.visual: 高大的人形、光羽之翼、过于对称的面容、金白光；高位者形态非人（多翼、多眼）。

references.work: 伪狄奥尼修斯《天阶体系》
references.note: 三阶九级（座天使即 Ophanim 等说法属后世）

image.brief: Two adult celestial beings standing side by side, taller than humans, flawless symmetrical faces with calm luminous eyes, warm golden light emanating softly from their skin, each with a pair of large real white feathered wings folded behind them; the male-presenting one in simple flowing white and gold robes with a plain bronze breastplate holding a long spear, the female-presenting one in layered white robes holding a sheathed sword; serene, solemn, slightly inhuman. Avoid any religious iconography such as crosses or halos shaped as rings.

entries.name: 天恩之子
entries.summary: 凡人与天界存在的后代：身上有天光，力量源于圣光的血，传说注定要做出影响世界的选择。

xianxia.concept: 仙凡之子 / 谪仙后裔（参照）
xianxia.note: 传统文献中的 nephilim 是巨人且多被视为可憎，本库不用其本义，只作别名。

details.觉醒标志: 背后浮现光翼的轮廓、瞳孔金化
details.弱点: 被天界与深渊同时盯上
details.欧美观众热度: 高：天使之子与恶魔之子的禁忌之恋

entries.visual: 过于明亮的眼睛、皮肤透出暖光，觉醒时背后浮现光翼。

references.note: nephilim（本库取其「天人混血」的通俗含义）

image.brief: Two adult angel-born humans standing clearly apart with a gap between them: a man and a woman with unusually luminous golden-hazel eyes and skin with a faint warm inner glow, the woman's pale gold hair and the man's dark hair catching the light; they wear simple undyed linen and pale grey wool clothes; behind EACH of them, separately, a complete pair of large faint translucent feathered wings made of light is just becoming visible (two wings per person, four wings in total); humble, startled, awakening.

subgroups.name: 妖精与长生种
subgroups.intro: 妖精不是小翅膀精灵，而是来自彼岸的古老存在：不会说谎、必须守约、怕冷铁。精灵是会「褪去」的长生种。

entries.name: 妖精
entries.summary: 来自彼岸妖精国度的存在：从微小的花精到美得令人窒息的宫廷贵族。力量来自幻魅、交易与真名，被铁、被誓言、被自己的规则所束缚。

xianxia.concept: 山精野怪 / 洞天仙灵（参照）
xianxia.note: 差异：妖精最重要的是「规则」——不能说谎（但会误导）、交易必须对等、知道真名即可约束、吃了妖精的食物就回不去。剧作冲突几乎都来自这些规则。

details.力量源: 幻魅（幻术+惑控）、自然、契约
details.本族等级链: 小精怪 Lesser Fae（花精、家精）→ 宫廷骑士 Fae Knight → 领主/夫人 Lord/Lady → 君主 Monarch（夏之女王 / 冬之女王）
details.核心规则: 不能说谎；必须履约；冷铁灼伤；真名约束；彼岸时间流速不同
details.社会结构: 两大宫廷：光辉宫廷 Seelie 与幽暗宫廷 Unseelie
details.欧美观众热度: 高：妖精王子、与妖精的交易、被带走的凡人

entries.visual: 过于完美的美貌带一点「不对劲」：瞳孔异形、耳尖、皮肤微光，衣饰取自花叶、霜、羽、骨。

references.note: Seelie / Unseelie 宫廷、冷铁、妖精食物
妖精宫廷浪漫小说的流行

image.brief: A ring of pale glowing mushrooms in a moonlit forest clearing, inside it a crowd of tiny winged sprites like glowing moths and two small mischievous hob-like creatures, and standing just outside the ring a tall elegant fae lord in silver-and-green clothes whose shadow does not match his shape; enchanting and slightly sinister.

entries.name: 光辉宫廷
entries.summary: 较为「友善」的妖精宫廷：向凡人赐福、回报善意，但同样记仇、同样残酷，只是更讲礼。

details.对凡人: 以礼相待，以恩相报，也以恩相挟

entries.visual: 花冠、金绿织物、夏日光斑。

image.brief: Two adult fae nobles of a summer court, unearthly beautiful with subtly pointed ears, luminous golden-brown skin with faint shimmering freckles, eyes a little too bright; the woman in a gown of layered petals and gold-green gauze with a living flower crown, the man in a fitted coat of leaf-patterned gold brocade with a circlet of woven branches and tiny blossoms; gracious smiles that feel slightly dangerous.

entries.name: 幽暗宫廷
entries.summary: 黑暗而危险的妖精宫廷：猎捕凡人、喜好恐惧与恶作剧，但也守约守规，从不撒谎。

details.对凡人: 以猎物与玩物视之；但交易仍须对等

entries.visual: 霜与黑羽、骨饰、苍白的皮肤与黑色眼白。

image.brief: Backdrop: a plain cold blue-grey studio backdrop, lit with cool moonlight-blue key light. Two adult fae nobles of a winter court, a man and a woman: sharply pointed ears, and all visible skin (face, ears, neck and chest) is icy pale with a distinct cold blue frost sheen, as if dusted with hoarfrost, with small white frost crystals on the cheekbones, brows and hairline; eyes whose sclera are completely black with no white visible, with bright silver irises; lips a cold bluish tone. The man wears a high collar of black feathers with frost-rimed silver embroidery and a crown of thin antler and ice; the woman wears a dark violet gown neckline edged with frost crystals and raven feathers, a necklace of small bones and moonstones. No warm skin tones, no pink. Elegant, predatory, beautiful.

entries.name: 精灵
entries.summary: 长生、优雅、与星辰或森林相连的古老种族。成长以世纪计，天生亲近奥术与自然，但人口稀少、繁衍极慢，正在缓慢衰退。族内按年岁论地位，施法者另按职业头衔论强弱。

xianxia.note: 差异：精灵的长生带着「哀愁」——他们会厌倦世界并「褪去」（fade），离开凡世前往彼岸，这是西幻精灵的核心悲剧感。

details.寿命: 七百年至无尽；不老，但会「褪去」
details.觉醒特点: 觉醒率高、成长极慢；长者多为怪物至恐怖级，古老者偶达灾厄
details.本族等级链: 幼芽 Sapling（百岁内，被视为孩子）→ 盛年 Bloom → 长者 Elder → 古老者 Ancient → 褪去 Faded（离开凡世）
details.社会结构: 长老议会与古老家族；血统与年岁即地位
details.弱点: 傲慢、繁衍慢、难以适应变化
details.与他族: 视人类为短命孩童；与矮人有旧怨
details.欧美观众热度: 中：精灵王子/公主恋爱

entries.visual: 尖耳、细长骨架、无瑕的皮肤、长发，服饰为流动的织物与叶脉纹金属。

references.note: 长生与离开中土（机制参考，不用专名）

image.brief: An ancient elven city built into a forest of colossal silver-barked trees at dusk: round domed pavilions of pale green-veined stone set on broad platforms high in the branches, connected by spiral stairways wound around the trunks and rope-and-crystal lantern lines, star-shaped skylights glowing, no pointed arches and no waterfalls, a few tiny slender figures on a stair for scale; graceful, melancholic, timeless.

entries.name: 高等精灵
entries.summary: 居住在白石城邦的精灵：奥术最精深的种族，以星辰为历法与魔力之源，文化高度仪式化。
entries.visual: 白银与深蓝的长袍、星形银饰，发色浅金或银。

references.note: high elf 已是通用类型词

image.brief: Two adult high elves with long pointed ears, tall and slender, pale luminous skin, silver-white hair cut in an unusual style: the man's hair cropped short at the sides with a long single braid, the woman's hair pinned high with silver star-shaped pins; the man in a deep-blue robe with a stiff high collar embroidered with silver constellations, the woman in a structured midnight-blue and silver gown with a star-map pattern and a small silver star brooch, no circlet, no white gauze; serene, proud, ageless.

entries.name: 林地精灵
entries.summary: 住在古林中的精灵：游侠与德鲁伊之族，与森林的生死绑在一起，排外而警觉。
entries.visual: 皮革与叶片织物的猎装、长弓、身上的木纹刺青。

image.brief: Two adult wood elves with long pointed ears, lithe athletic builds, sun-browned skin with faint leaf-vein tattoos, hair in auburn and dark brown braids woven with green leaves, acorn caps and small seed beads (no feathers); both in close-fitting hunting garb of layered leather and leaf-patterned green and brown cloth, one with a tall longbow, one with a slim spear; alert, watchful expressions.

entries.name: 影精灵
entries.summary: 被同族放逐的精灵后裔：先祖拥抱了暗影与死亡魔法，被逐出精灵城邦，如今流落在森林边缘的暮光地带，以秘术和情报为生。

xianxia.concept: 被逐出宗门的魔道分支（参照）
xianxia.note: 本库原创：核心是「被放逐的同族」与「会动的影子」；不用地下城、畏光、深肤色等现有暗精灵设定。

details.社会: 流亡家族的契约网络，重视秘密

entries.visual: 与其他精灵一样多样的肤色；特征在于影子——他们的影子比身体慢半拍，眼睛是暮色般的灰紫，常穿流放者的灰黑丧服。

references.work: 北欧 dökkálfar / 现代奇幻
references.note: 暗精灵原型（避开现有作品的蜘蛛母系设定）

image.brief: Two adult exiled elves with long pointed ears: one with deep brown skin and one with olive skin, dusk-violet grey eyes, dark hair streaked with silver; both dressed in layered mourning garments of charcoal and deep plum with silver clasps and long hooded mantles; on the floor at their feet their shadows are posed differently from their bodies, lagging a moment behind. Guarded, elegant, melancholic.

entries.name: 半精灵
entries.summary: 人类与精灵的孩子：寿命介于两者之间，两边都不完全接纳，常成为两族之间的使者、游侠或吟游诗人。

details.力量源: 奥术或自然（随精灵一方）
details.社会: 无本族社会，常游走于两族之间

entries.visual: 耳尖微尖、比人类更修长，眼睛颜色偏浅。

image.brief: Two adult half-elves standing side by side: slightly taller and slimmer than average humans, ears only slightly pointed at the tips, light hazel and grey eyes; the man in a traveler's leather coat with a short sword and a lute strapped to his back, the woman in a ranger's green wool cloak with a longbow; faces mixing human warmth and elven poise.

entries.name: 人类
entries.summary: 寿命最短、觉醒最快、路线最广的种族：没有天生的魔法，却能学会一切，建立了大陆上最多的王国与教会。

xianxia.note: 同为主角种族。差异：西幻人类被长生种视为「年轻而贪婪」，优势是野心与变化，短命反而成为他们能改变命运的理由。

details.寿命: 60–80 岁（生命之酒、契约、神恩可延长）
details.力量源: 全部九种皆可，奥术与圣光最普遍
details.觉醒特点: 觉醒率约一成，成长最快，上限因人而异
details.社会结构: 王国—贵族家族—教会—行会—平民
details.与他族: 与精灵互相轻视又依赖；与矮人贸易；与兽人世仇或同盟视剧而定
details.欧美观众热度: 主角默认种族；常为「被隐藏的混血」

entries.visual: 多样的人种与服饰，按王国区分。

references.note: 人类作为短命而进取的中心种族

image.brief: Two ordinary adult humans of a medieval fantasy kingdom with completely normal human features (round human ears, no horns, no scales, no fins, no glowing eyes): a man in a practical wool tunic, leather vest and boots with a short sword at his belt, and a woman in a linen dress with a laced bodice and a hooded travel cloak carrying a satchel; realistic diverse faces, ordinary yet determined people.

entries.name: 半身人
entries.summary: 身高约人类一半的安居小民：务农、开旅店、驾河船经商，重家族与好客，看似平凡，却有惊人的运气与韧性。

xianxia.note: 通用类型词；避免托尔金式的光脚毛足、洞穴房屋与 hobbit 一词。

details.力量源: 勇武（运气与韧性）、少量自然
details.本族等级链: 家族长老会；最受尊敬的是家族长母或长父

entries.visual: 矮小匀称、穿靴子的旅人或船夫装束，圆耳。

references.note: 小人族与家宅精灵传说

image.brief: Two adult halflings who look exactly like ordinary adult humans scaled down, with normal adult proportions and round ears (not dwarf-like, not child-like), standing in front of an ordinary full-size wooden house door and a full-size wine barrel: the top of each halfling's head reaches only halfway up the door and they are about as tall as the barrel; a man and a woman dressed as river-boat traders in sturdy boots, oilskin coats, wool scarves and wide-brimmed hats, one carrying a coil of rope and a lantern, the other a ledger case; cheerful, shrewd faces.

entries.name: 矮人
entries.summary: 住在山中的匠人与战士之族：几乎不施法，却是最好的符文匠与铁匠；重誓言、重祖先、重手艺。

xianxia.concept: 炼器世家 / 体修宗门（参照）

details.体型: 矮壮，约 1.3 米，骨密度极高
details.力量源: 符文与工艺、勇武；天生抗魔
details.觉醒特点: 极少觉醒奥术，勇武与符文成就高
details.本族等级链: 族人 → 匠人（出师）→ 领主 Thane → 族长 Clan Lord → 山王 High King；手艺大师与族长同尊
details.社会结构: 氏族与山城，祖先祭祀，誓言石
details.弱点: 固执、记仇、不善水与航海
details.与他族: 与人类贸易；与精灵旧怨；与哥布林争夺地下
details.欧美观众热度: 低：多为配角

entries.visual: 编辫长须、厚重的工作服与锁甲、符文刻纹的锤斧。

references.note: 现代矮人形象（只取类型）

image.brief: Two adult dwarves, short and very stocky with broad shoulders and thick forearms, about chest height to a human; the man with a long braided auburn beard bound with bronze rings, wearing a chainmail shirt under a heavy leather smith's apron and carrying a war hammer engraved with angular marks; the woman with thick braided black hair and a braided sideburn, in a sturdy quilted tunic and leather bracers holding a rune-carved axe; proud, stubborn faces.

entries.name: 兽人
entries.summary: 强壮的战士民族：重荣誉、血誓与先祖，以战功和誓约决定地位。常被其他种族视为野蛮，实则有严格的习惯法与血金（wergild）制度。

xianxia.note: 取材于古代欧洲的战士社会（日耳曼部落、草原游牧），不是「天生邪恶」也不是「高贵野蛮人」。

details.本族等级链: 幼崽 Whelp → 见血者 Blooded（首次战斗后）→ 誓士 Sworn（在誓环上立誓入战帮）→ 勇士 Champion → 战王 War-King；挑战与推举均可继位
details.社会结构: 氏族与战帮，长屋议事，血金习惯法
details.弱点: 部落间内斗，被他族歧视
details.欧美观众热度: 中：兽人酋长与人类公主的恋爱（女性向）

entries.visual: 灰橄榄至褐色皮肤、下獠牙、编发、铁项圈与臂环、鳞甲与毛毡。

references.note: orc 已为通用类型词（只用类型，不用任何作品外观与头衔）

references.work: 古代日耳曼与斯基泰社会

image.brief: Two adult orcs, tall and heavily muscled, olive-grey skin, prominent lower tusks, dark hair worn in thick braids; the man in a scale-mail shirt over a wool tunic, a twisted iron torc around the neck and iron arm-rings, holding a long-hafted war axe; the woman in a belted felt and leather coat with bronze clasps and a fur-trimmed cloak, an iron oath-ring on her arm, holding a round shield and a spear; proud, dignified, composed expressions.

entries.name: 巨人
entries.summary: 比世界更古老的巨大种族，按元素分支（霜、火、石、风暴），曾统治大地，如今退守边疆。

xianxia.concept: 巨灵族 / 上古遗族（参照）

details.本族等级链: 按体型与年岁：年少者 → 酋长 → 巨王；王位以力量决斗决定
details.分支: 霜巨人（北境）、火巨人（火山）、石巨人（山脉）、风暴巨人（海崖）
details.弱点: 迟缓、人口稀少、怕被诡计戏耍（民间故事中常被聪明的凡人骗倒）
details.欧美观众热度: 低

entries.visual: 巨大而粗犷的人形，皮肤带元素质感（霜、熔岩、岩石）。

image.brief: A frost giant standing beside a small single-story stone cottage whose roof eaves reach only the giant's hip, seen in a three-quarter side view: massive and broad, skin pale blue-grey with frost on the shoulders, long white braided beard with icicles, furs and crude iron plates, a huge club of ice-covered timber; a plain dark adult human silhouette at the cottage door reaches the giant's knee. The giant is about three and a half times the height of the human, not more.

entries.name: 巨魔
entries.summary: 北方山林中的大型人形生物：伤口能迅速再生，阳光会把它们变成石头。愚钝或狡诈，民间故事里常守着桥与宝藏。

details.本族等级链: 按年岁：年幼 → 成年 → 山王；年老的巨魔皮肤长苔藓、几乎与山石无异
details.欧美观众热度: 低

entries.visual: 苔藓般的粗糙皮肤、长鼻、石块状的指节。

image.brief: A hulking mountain troll in a three-quarter side view, hunched with very long arms, thick grey-green skin like weathered stone patched with moss and lichen, a long drooping nose, small deep-set eyes, knuckles like rocks, wearing only a ragged hide loincloth, one forearm already turning to cracked grey stone. The troll is about three meters tall: the adult human silhouette beside it reaches the troll's lower chest.

entries.name: 哥布林
entries.summary: 欧洲民间的小精怪：矮小、调皮、爱偷小东西、让牛奶变酸、在夜里敲门。有的住在人家里帮忙也捣乱（家精 hobgoblin），有的成群住在荒野与旧矿洞。

xianxia.concept: 小妖 / 山精 / 家宅精怪（参照）

details.本族等级链: 无固定等级，以帮伙为单位，最狡猾者为头
details.核心规则: 被款待则帮忙，被冒犯则捣乱；怕冷铁与教堂钟声
details.欧美观众热度: 低：喜剧配角

entries.visual: 矮小精瘦、长尖耳、苔绿或灰褐皮肤、亮眼睛，穿着拼凑的旧衣与偷来的小饰物。

image.brief: Two adult goblins of European folklore about one meter tall, wiry and quick, with long pointed ears, small sharp features, mossy grey-green skin and bright amber eyes; one in a patched hooded smock with a stolen silver spoon and a ribbon tied around its wrist, the other in a ragged waistcoat holding a stub of candle and a sack of mismatched buttons; mischievous impish grins.

entries.name: 人鱼
entries.summary: 海中的人形种族：上身似人、下身鱼尾，以歌声与潮汐魔法闻名。可在月夜短暂化腿上岸，代价各族不同。

details.本族等级链: 歌者 → 潮汐祭司 → 海王/海后；地位由歌声的力量决定
details.欧美观众热度: 高：人鱼与人类的恋爱（上岸的代价）

entries.visual: 鳞片沿颈与手臂延伸、鱼鳍状耳、湿发与珍珠贝饰。

references.work: 欧洲民间与安徒生童话

image.brief: Two adult merfolk resting half out of shallow sea water on a rock against a plain grey studio-like seaside backdrop: a merman and a mermaid, human upper bodies with iridescent blue-green scales spreading along the neck, shoulders and forearms, fin-like ears, long wet hair with pearls and shell ornaments, powerful fish tails with translucent fins fully visible curling over the rock; serene, wild beauty.

entries.name: 海豹人
entries.summary: 披上海豹皮就是海豹、脱下就是人的海民。谁偷走并藏起她的海豹皮，她就不得不留在陆地上——直到找回为止。

xianxia.note: 与中国「天鹅处女/七仙女羽衣」是同型故事，凯尔特版本以海豹皮为核心。

details.核心禁忌: 海豹皮被夺即被困陆地
details.欧美观众热度: 中：被困的妻子、找回海豹皮的那一刻

entries.visual: 深色湿润的大眼睛，随身的灰色海豹皮斗篷。

image.brief: Two adult selkies standing barefoot on wet pebbles: a woman and a man with large dark liquid eyes, sleek dark hair, simple undyed wool clothing, each with a heavy cloak made from a spotted grey sealskin with the seal's head as a hood draped over the shoulders, sea spray droplets on their skin; quiet, wistful, otherworldly.

entries.name: 半人马
entries.summary: 上身为人、下身为马的草原与林地民族：善射、观星、通晓医药与预言，也有狂野好斗的部族。

xianxia.concept: 无直接对应（希腊神话种族）

details.体型: 马身，站立时头部约 2.5 米
details.本族等级链: 群落按年岁与学识：年轻射手 → 长者 → 观星者

entries.visual: 马身强健、人身佩弓箭与星图护符。

image.brief: Two adult centaurs of Greek myth standing side by side in a three-quarter view, human upper bodies joined to the bodies of strong horses (one bay, one dappled grey), all four hooves visible; the male wears a draped linen chiton over one shoulder, a laurel wreath and carries a bronze-tipped bow, the female a pinned wool himation and a small bronze star-chart pendant; neat braided hair, no face paint, no feathers, no beads; calm wise faces. A plain dark adult human silhouette stands beside them, its head level with the horse-shoulders.

subgroups.name: 变形者与诅咒者
subgroups.intro: 力量来自血或诅咒、无法选择的种族；等级链与伴侣羁绊是核心。

entries.name: 狼人
entries.summary: 满月或情绪激动时化为巨狼的变形者：以狼群为单位生活，等级森严，靠嗅觉与「伴侣羁绊」认定命中之人。

xianxia.note: 欧美短剧通行套路已形成完整体系：Alpha 统领狼群，其伴侣称 Luna；命定伴侣（mate）由月之女神指定，被「拒绝伴侣」是女性向的退婚流。

details.体型: 人形略高大；狼形如小马
details.本族等级链: Omega（最低，常被欺凌）→ Delta/Gamma（护卫、执法）→ Beta（副手）→ Alpha（狼群首领）；Alpha 的伴侣为 Luna；之上有 Lycan 王族（纯血始祖）
details.核心规则: Alpha 之令（Alpha command）可强制服从；命定伴侣只有一位；被拒绝会带来剧痛；无主之狼称 Rogue
details.欧美观众热度: 极高：女性向头号题材
details.时代变体: 现代都市狼人题材可把服装与组织改为当代，规则不变

entries.visual: 人形时金或琥珀色眼睛、强壮体魄；狼形为巨大的狼，毛色延续人形发色。

references.note: Alpha / Luna / mate bond 套路（社区通行，非某一作品专有）

image.brief: Two adult werewolves in human form standing side by side, athletic and powerful builds, fully human ears and faces, no fur, glowing amber-gold eyes and a hint of sharp canines being the only signs; the man in a dark leather jerkin over a linen shirt with a fur-trimmed cloak and riding boots, the woman in a fitted dark green wool riding coat with a belt and boots; behind them in soft focus a huge dark grey wolf the size of a pony sits watching. Intense and magnetic.

entries.name: 吸血鬼
entries.summary: 以血为生的不死贵族：永生、俊美、力大无穷，惧阳光与圣物。按「血统」组成家族，越古老的血越强。

xianxia.concept: 血魔 / 尸修中的贵族（参照）

details.本族等级链: 血仆 Thrall（饮了吸血鬼血的凡人，非吸血鬼）→ 新生者 Fledgling → 吸血鬼 → 长老 Elder（数百岁）→ 古老者 Ancient（千岁）→ 始祖 Progenitor（一个血统的源头）
details.核心规则: 未经邀请不能进入住宅；阳光灼烧；木桩穿心与斩首可杀；圣物与银令其痛苦；转化凡人需互饮血并「死去一次」
details.社会结构: 血统家族与血族议会，长老统治
details.弱点: 阳光、圣物、木桩、火、流水（部分血统）
details.欧美观众热度: 极高：吸血鬼王与人类新娘

entries.visual: 苍白无瑕的皮肤、饥饿时瞳孔变红、尖牙，偏爱旧式贵族服装。

image.brief: Two adult vampires of an old noble bloodline, flawless porcelain-pale skin, deep red irises, a hint of fangs visible in a faint smile; the man in an immaculate black velvet tailcoat with a high collar, a dark red silk cravat and a signet ring; the woman in a dark burgundy velvet gown with a high lace collar and a black choker with a ruby; aristocratic, seductive, cold.

entries.name: 半吸血鬼
entries.summary: 吸血鬼与凡人的孩子：巴尔干民间相信他们天生能看见隐形的吸血鬼，是最好的吸血鬼猎人。不怕阳光，力量与感官超常，但血里有饥渴。

details.能力: 看见隐形之物、感知吸血鬼、超常感官
details.代价: 对血的渴望；两边都不接纳
details.欧美观众热度: 中

entries.visual: 苍白但有血色，瞳孔偶尔泛红，尖牙不明显。

image.brief: Backdrop: plain dark slate grey. Two adult dhampirs, half-vampire humans: round human ears, pale but healthy skin, and in each eye a clearly visible thin bright red ring around the outer edge of the iris (the eyelids and whites of the eyes are normal, not bloodshot); sharp attentive features; the man in a high-collared worn travel coat, the woman in a dark leather jerkin over a linen shirt; watchful, restless expressions.

entries.name: 魔裔
entries.summary: 凡人与恶魔的后代：外貌带角、尾或异色瞳，天生能用深渊之力，被教会追猎、被恶魔觊觎。

xianxia.concept: 半魔 / 魔族混血（参照）

details.社会: 无本族社会，散居于人类之中，常隐藏身份
details.弱点: 圣物、恶魔真名对其同样有效
details.欧美观众热度: 高：隐藏的恶魔之子

entries.visual: 小角（可被头发或帽子遮住）、深红或金色瞳、体温偏高。

references.note: cambion：梦魔与凡人之子（梅林的传说出身之一）

image.brief: Two adult cambions, half-demon humans with round human ears: the woman with a pair of small curved dark horns partly hidden in her dark wavy hair, deep crimson eyes, wearing a high-collared dark grey dress with a hooded cloak; the man with short swept-back ridged horns, golden eyes, faint ember-like markings on the neck, wearing a dark tailored coat; no tails, normal human skin tones; both trying to look ordinary, guarded expressions.

entries.name: 亡灵
entries.summary: 死后仍未安息的存在：有的是被死灵术唤起的躯壳，有的是执念未了的亡魂，最强者是主动放弃生命以换不朽的巫妖。

details.来源: 死灵术、诅咒、执念、自我转化
details.本族等级链: 行尸 Ghoul/Zombie（无意志）→ 归来者 Revenant（有执念与意志）→ 怨灵 Wraith（无形之魂）→ 巫妖 Lich（以护命匣自造的不死法师）→ 恐惧领主 Dread Lord（统治亡灵大军者）
details.亡魂分支: 幽魂 Ghost、报丧女妖 Banshee（见生物）
details.弱点: 圣光、圣水、盐、完成执念、毁掉护命匣
details.欧美观众热度: 中：鬼魂恋人、复仇归来者
details.巫妖: 保留生前的法术造诣，常为恐怖级以上

entries.visual: 从腐朽躯体到半透明魂影；巫妖为枯骨王者，眼窝燃冷火。

image.brief: A lich: a gaunt undead sorcerer-king of human size, a skeletal face with tight dried grey skin, eye sockets burning with cold pale-blue fire, wearing tattered layered black and deep purple royal robes with tarnished silver embroidery, a corroded iron crown with plain rounded points, skeletal hands holding a staff with a cage containing a glowing pale gem; a plain human silhouette stands right beside it for scale and the lich is only slightly taller than the human.

subgroups.name: 深渊存在
subgroups.intro: 以灵魂与契约为食的存在。

entries.name: 恶魔
entries.summary: 深渊与地狱的居民：以灵魂为食、以契约为法，渴望进入凡世。它们不会创造，只能交易、诱惑与吞噬。

xianxia.note: 差异：西方恶魔的核心是「交易与真名」——被召唤者知道真名就能约束它；它们必须遵守契约字面意义，所以斗智是主线。

details.寿命: 永恒；在凡世被杀会退回深渊
details.本族等级链: 小鬼 Imp → 次级恶魔 Lesser Fiend → 高阶恶魔 Greater Fiend → 有爵位的恶魔（骑士 Knight → 伯爵 Earl → 侯爵 Marquis → 公爵 Duke）→ 亲王 Prince → 魔王 King；爵位体系取自中世纪魔法书
details.成长方式: 收集灵魂与契约、吞噬同类
details.核心规则: 真名约束；必须履行契约字面；不能主动进入无邀请的圣地；在凡世需宿主或召唤阵
details.弱点: 圣光、圣物、真名、契约漏洞
details.欧美观众热度: 高：恶魔契约之恋、恶魔王子

entries.visual: 从小而丑陋的小鬼到俊美得危险的人形贵族；角、蝠翼、尾、熔岩裂纹、硫磺烟。

references.note: 恶魔的王、公、侯、伯、骑士爵位
七种爵位：王、亲王、公、侯、总裁、伯、骑士；骑士只有 Furcas 一位

image.brief: Two adult high-ranking demons in their elegant human-like forms: tall, beautiful in an unsettling way, with large curved black horns, eyes of molten orange with black sclera, faint glowing lava-like cracks along the neck and hands; the male in a sharply tailored black and crimson long coat with a high collar, the female in a fitted black gown with ember-red lining and a smoke-like train; a hint of dark bat-like wings folded behind them; charismatic, menacing smiles.

entries.name: 堕落天使
entries.summary: 质疑命令或爱上凡人而被逐出天界的天使：翅膀焦黑或被剪去，保留永生与部分力量，失去圣光与归途。在深渊里他们是最高位的恶魔贵族；在凡世他们隐姓埋名。

details.失去: 圣光、天界之门、部分记忆
details.核心规则: 可以说谎（这是堕落的标志）；被原谅或赎罪可重返（默认极难）
details.欧美观众热度: 高：堕落天使之恋

entries.visual: 焦黑或残缺的羽翼、过于完美的面容带一道伤，眼中金光变为余烬。

image.brief: Two adult fallen angels standing side by side, tall with flawless faces each marked by a single thin scar, eyes of dim ember-gold; behind each of them a pair of large wings with scorched, blackened and partly torn feathers; the male-presenting one in a long dark grey coat with a tarnished bronze breastplate beneath, the female-presenting one in a layered black and ash-white gown with a broken gold circlet; proud, sorrowful, dangerous.

entries.name: 梦魔
entries.summary: 在梦中诱惑凡人、以其生命力与欲念为食的恶魔：男为 incubus，女为 succubus。能在梦境中自由出入，现实中需借召唤或附身显形。

xianxia.concept: 魅魔 / 采补魔修（参照）

details.进食方式: 在梦中汲取生命力与欲念，受害者日渐憔悴
details.核心规则: 被叫出真名即受约束；无法进入有护梦符或圣物守护的卧室；真心的爱会灼伤它们（默认）
details.欧美观众热度: 高

entries.visual: 现实中是俊美的人形，梦中显出角、尾与烟一样的双翼。

image.brief: Two adult dream demons standing side by side like aristocrats from a dream: a man and a woman with small elegant curved horns and slender tails, fully clothed in long high-collared formal robes of deep violet and black velvet with silver embroidery, long sleeves, wings made of drifting dark smoke rather than feathers, eyes glowing soft violet, a faint dreamy haze and floating moth-like motes around them; mysterious, regal, unsettling.

subgroups.name: 链外：龙与元素
subgroups.intro: 比存在之链更古老的力量。

entries.name: 龙
entries.summary: 最古老、最强大的生灵：会说话、会魔法、守着宝藏，随年岁不断变强。部分古龙能化为人形行走于世。

xianxia.note: 差异：西方龙是贪婪与力量的象征，不是祥瑞；龙与宝藏绑定——宝藏越多越强，失去宝藏会暴怒。

details.本族等级链: 幼龙 Wyrmling → 少年龙 Young → 成年龙 Adult → 长老龙 Elder → 古龙 Ancient → 巨龙 Great Wyrm；以年岁与宝藏衡量
details.分支: 按元素：火、霜、风暴、毒（沼泽）、岩
details.核心规则: 龙语（言出即法）、宝藏执念、龙血能赋予凡人力量
details.弱点: 腹下软鳞、贪婪、被诡计欺骗
details.欧美观众热度: 中：龙骑士、化人形的龙王

entries.visual: 四足双翼、长颈长尾、鳞片如铠甲、熔金竖瞳。

image.brief: Two adult dragons in human form standing side by side on a stone floor lit by a low strong light from the front: a man and a woman of commanding presence with clearly visible vertical slit-pupil golden eyes, patches of bronze scales along the jaw, neck and backs of the hands, dressed in heavy dark red wool and bronze-plated leather garments of a northern European warlord style with a gold torc and gold arm-rings, no earrings, no coins; from each person's feet a long shadow stretches back across the floor, and each shadow has the shape of a four-legged winged dragon.

entries.name: 元素生灵
entries.summary: 火、水、土、风本身的灵性化身：从小小的火蜥蜴到能掀起山崩的元素领主。元素使与它们谈判、签约、借力。

details.四类原型: 火—火蜥蜴 Salamander；水—水妖 Undine；风—风精 Sylph；土—地灵 Gnome（帕拉塞尔苏斯的四元素精灵）
details.本族等级链: 灵火/微灵 Wisp → 元素灵 Elemental → 大元素灵 Greater Elemental → 元素领主 Elemental Lord
details.核心规则: 需现场有对应元素；契约以「供奉」维持
details.欧美观众热度: 低

entries.visual: 由元素本身构成的形体，带人或兽的轮廓。

image.brief: A greater fire elemental in a three-quarter side view: a towering humanoid shape about four meters tall made entirely of living real fire and glowing molten rock, a core of white-hot flame in its chest, a face suggested by darker embers, flames streaming upward from its shoulders and head, the floor beneath scorched; a small plain human silhouette stands at its feet for scale.
